question: Mangal Pandey was hanged to death for attacking British officers in Barrackpore on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 April 1857.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangal Pandey **was an Indian soldier who played a key part in the events immediately preceding t**he outbreak of the Indian Rebellion** of 1857.
 
• He was a Sepoy in the** 34th Bengal Native Infantry regiment of the British East India Compan**y.
 
• Due to his attack on two British officers, Mangal Pandey was hanged to death on 8 April 1857, at the age of 29.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **new Enfield rifle **was introduced in India by the British and the rumour going around was that the cartridges were **greased with animal fat**, primarily from pigs and cows.
 
• To use the rifle, the soldiers would have to bite off the ends of the greased cartridges in order to load the gun. Since **cows are holy animals to Hindus **and **pigs are considered repugnant to Muslims**, it's use was considered controversial by the Indian soldiers.
 
• The Indian soldiers thought that the British did this on purpose to dishonour the religion of the Indian soldiers. At the Barrackpore ground near Kolkata, on 8 April 1857, Pandey was hanged to death.
